course.title: Unit 6 Nature and us-Part C--【例句】

sentences.content: There are many rivers and big trees here.
sentences.english: There are many rivers and big trees here
sentences.chinese: 这里有许多河流和参天大树。

sentences.content: There are a lot of fish in the rivers.
sentences.english: There are a lot of fish in the rivers
sentences.chinese: 河流中有很多鱼。

wordDetails.definition: are（现在式）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: You can go boating on the river with your friends.
sentences.english: You can go boating on the river with your friends
sentences.chinese: 你可以和朋友们一起在河上划船。

sentences.content: There is heavy rain in summer.
sentences.english: There is heavy rain in summer
sentences.chinese: 夏季多暴雨。

sentences.content: Sometimes there are floods too.
sentences.english: Sometimes there are floods too
sentences.chinese: 有时也会发生洪水。

sentences.content: Check the weather report before you go.
sentences.english: Check the weather report before you go
sentences.chinese: 出发前查看天气预报。

sentences.content: Have a good time in Mountain Nature Park
sentences.english: Have a good time in Mountain Nature Park
sentences.chinese: 在Mountain Nature Park玩得开心

sentences.content: There are many mountains, and there is a big forest.
sentences.english: There are many mountains , and there is a big forest
sentences.chinese: 这里群山环绕，还有一片广袤的森林。

sentences.content: It is a great place to hike or walk your dog.
sentences.english: It is a great place to hike or walk your dog
sentences.chinese: 这是个远足或遛狗的好地方。

sentences.content: There is often heavy fog on spring mornings.
sentences.english: There is often heavy fog on spring mornings
sentences.chinese: 春天的早晨常常浓雾弥漫。

sentences.content: Don't go into the forest then.
sentences.english: Don't go into the forest then
sentences.chinese: 那就别进森林了。

sentences.content: In autumn, it is often windy.
sentences.english: In autumn , it is often windy
sentences.chinese: 秋天常常刮风。

sentences.content: Be careful of fires.
sentences.english: Be careful of fires
sentences.chinese: 小心火灾。

sentences.content: Welcome to Waterfall Nature Park
sentences.english: Welcome to Waterfall Nature Park
sentences.chinese: 欢迎来到Waterfall Nature Park

sentences.content: There is a big waterfall here.
sentences.english: There is a big waterfall here
sentences.chinese: 这里有一个大瀑布。

sentences.content: You can take pictures of your family near the waterfall.
sentences.english: You can take pictures of your family near the waterfall
sentences.chinese: 你可以在瀑布附近为家人拍照。

sentences.content: It is very cold in winter.
sentences.english: It is very cold in winter
sentences.chinese: 冬天非常寒冷。

sentences.content: Sometimes there is heavy snow.
sentences.english: Sometimes there is heavy snow
sentences.chinese: 有时会下大雪。

sentences.content: Check the weather report before you go.
sentences.english: Check the weather report before you go
sentences.chinese: 出门前查看一下天气预报。

sentences.content: Step 1: Choose a nature park.
sentences.english: Step 1 : Choose a nature park
sentences.chinese: 第一步：选择一处自然公园。

sentences.content: Step 2: Find out about the weather there in each season.
sentences.english: Step 2 : Find out about the weather there in each season
sentences.chinese: 第二步：了解当地每个季节的天气情况。

wordDetails.definition: find out（短语动词）: 找出

sentences.content: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter
sentences.english: Spring , Summer , Autumn , Winter
sentences.chinese: 春，夏，秋，冬

sentences.content: Step 3: Write a welcome letter to visitors.
sentences.english: Step 3 : Write a welcome letter to visitors
sentences.chinese: 第三步：撰写致访客的欢迎信。

sentences.content: Dear visitors,
sentences.english: Dear visitors
sentences.chinese: 尊敬的访客们，

sentences.content: I'd like to welcome you to our nature park.
sentences.english: I'd like to welcome you to our nature park
sentences.chinese: 欢迎您来到我们的自然公园。

sentences.content: There are so many things to see here.
sentences.english: There are so many things to see here
sentences.chinese: 这里有许多值得一看的东西。

sentences.content: There are also so many interesting things to do.
sentences.english: There are also so many interesting things to do
sentences.chinese: 还有这么多有趣的事情可以做。

sentences.content: The weather here is usually good, but sometimes it can be bad.
sentences.english: The weather here is usually good , but sometimes it can be bad
sentences.chinese: 这里的天气通常很好，但有时也会变糟。

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是

sentences.content: check the weather report before you come.
sentences.english: check the weather report before you come
sentences.chinese: 来之前查看一下天气预报。

sentences.content: Have a great time at the park, but please stay safe!
sentences.english: Have a great time at the park , but please stay safe !
sentences.chinese: 祝您在公园玩得开心，但请注意安全！

sentences.content: Sanjiangyuan National Park is in Qinghai.
sentences.english: Sanjiangyuan National Park is in Qinghai
sentences.chinese: 三江源国家公园位于青海。

sentences.content: It is the largest national park in China.
sentences.english: It is the largest national park in China
sentences.chinese: 它是中国最大的国家公园。

sentences.content: Do you think you can see it all in a week?
sentences.english: Do you think you can see it all in a week ?
sentences.chinese: 你觉得一周时间能看遍所有吗？

sentences.content: Some people say you need a month!
sentences.english: Some people say you need a month !
sentences.chinese: 有人说你需要一个月！

sentences.content: There are so many beautiful views.
sentences.english: There are so many beautiful views
sentences.chinese: 这里有许多美丽的景色。

sentences.content: You can see snowy mountains and much more.
sentences.english: You can see snowy mountains and much more
sentences.chinese: 你可以看到雪山，还有更多美景。

sentences.content: There are also three great rivers.
sentences.english: There are also three great rivers
sentences.chinese: 还有三条大河。

sentences.content: The Yangtze River, the Yellow River and the Lancang River all start here.
sentences.english: The Yangtze River , the Yellow River and the Lancang River all start here
sentences.chinese: 长江、黄河和澜沧江均发源于此。

sentences.content: This place gives fresh water to millions of people in China.
sentences.english: This place gives fresh water to millions of people in China
sentences.chinese: 这个地方为数百万中国人提供淡水。

wordDetails.definition: give（第三人称单数现在式）: 提供

sentences.content: It is sometimes called the "Water Tower of China!"
sentences.english: It is sometimes called the " Water Tower of China !"
sentences.chinese: 它有时被称为中国的“水塔”！

sentences.content: The park is a gift from nature.
sentences.english: The park is a gift from nature
sentences.chinese: 这座公园是大自然馈赠的礼物。

sentences.content: There are many birds, fish and other animals.
sentences.english: There are many birds , fish and other animals
sentences.chinese: 这里有许多鸟类、鱼类和其他动物。

sentences.content: Sanjiangyuan National Park really is a magical place!
sentences.english: Sanjiangyuan National Park really is a magical place !
sentences.chinese: 三江源国家公园真是个神奇的地方！

sentences.content: There is so much to see!
sentences.english: There is so much to see !
sentences.chinese: 可看的东西太多了！

sentences.content: Are there any big animals there?
sentences.english: Are there any big animals there ?
sentences.chinese: 那里有什么大型动物吗？

sentences.content: Yes, there are.
sentences.english: Yes , there are
sentences.chinese: 是的，有。

sentences.content: And there will be more in the future!
sentences.english: And there will be more in the future !
sentences.chinese: 未来还会有更多！
